title: "Projects"
description: |
  Ongoing analysis projects from the group
---

Ongoing analysis and research projects from the group. For completed work, see our [publications](pubs.qmd). For reusable tools, see our [software](software.qmd).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(magrittr)
```

```{r load-team}
# Load team members and create lookup by GitHub username
team <- fs::dir_ls("_data/team", regexp = "\\w+\\-\\w+\\.yml") |>
  purrr::map(yaml::read_yaml)

team_by_github <- team %>%
  purrr::keep(~ !is.null(.x$github) && .x$github != "") %>%
  purrr::set_names(purrr::map_chr(., "github"))
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# Each project is described by its own YAML file in _data/projects/, with a
# title and text summary (see _data/projects/_schema.yml for the full set of
# fields).
projects <- fs::dir_ls("_data/projects", regexp = "\\w+\\-\\w+\\.yml") %>%
  purrr::map(yaml::read_yaml)

projects %>%
  purrr::map_chr(function(p) {
    # Link the title to the project's website/repo if available, otherwise
    # show it as plain text
    project_url <- p$url %||% (
      if (!is.null(p$repo) && p$repo != "") paste0("https://github.com/", p$repo) else ""
    )
    title_section <- if (!is.null(project_url) && project_url != "") {
      sprintf("[%s](%s)", p$title, project_url)
    } else {
      p$title
    }

    # Match listed team members to their profile for the contributors row
    contributors_section <- ""
    team_logins <- p$team %||% list()
    if (length(team_logins) > 0) {
      team_contributors <- team_logins %>%
        purrr::keep(~ .x %in% names(team_by_github)) %>%
        purrr::map(function(login) {
          tm <- team_by_github[[login]]
          list(name = tm$name, github = login)
        })

      if (length(team_contributors) > 0) {
        contributor_items <- purrr::map_chr(team_contributors, function(c) {
          sprintf(
            '<a href="https://github.com/%s" title="%s"><img src="https://github.com/%s.png?size=64" alt="%s" width="32" height="32"></a>',
            c$github, c$name, c$github, c$name
          )
        })
        contributors_section <- paste(contributor_items, collapse = " ")
      }
    }

    knitr::knit_expand(
      "_project-item.Rmd",
      title_section = title_section,
      summary = stringr::str_squish(p$summary),
      start = p$start %||% "",
      end = p$end %||% "",
      contributors_section = contributors_section
    )
  }) %>%
  { knitr::knit_child(text = unlist(.), quiet = TRUE) } %>%
  cat(sep = "\n")
```
